role: calibration: explain the 90% Eisenstein-norm failure rate
missing_theorem: None for ES. PROVED here (3-adic valuation, elementary): an Eisenstein norm is 3^k·m with m ≡ 1 (mod 3). So the world is 4·3^K/p = Σ 1/m_i with m_i Eisenstein norms prime to 3, e.g. 12/p at K = 1: a forced 3-adic constraint plus a numerator-12 lottery.
